column1: What three core elements do websites typically contain, according to the source material?
column2: Websites contain text, images, and graphics.

column1: How are websites delivered to the user?
column2: Websites are delivered via the Internet.

column1: Multimedia products are delivered via _____ installed on computers.
column2: programs

column1: What is the key difference in the delivery method between websites and multimedia products?
column2: Websites are delivered via the Internet, whereas multimedia products are delivered via programs installed on computers.

column1: Name one type of media asset commonly used when making websites and multimedia products.
column2: Photographs.

column1: Besides photographs, name another media asset used in websites and multimedia products.
column2: Video / film.

column1: What audio-based media assets are used in websites and multimedia products?
column2: Sound, audio, music, podcasts, or radio.

column1: What type of media asset is used for buttons, menus, and layout in websites?
column2: Graphics.

column1: What specialised file format is mentioned for playing e-books and brochures in dedicated software?
column2: PDFs.

column1: What type of content do social media platforms primarily allow users to post?
column2: User-generated content, such as photos and text.

column1: How are social media platforms usually funded?
column2: They are usually funded by advertising.

column1: What term describes applications installed onto smartphones, tablets, and smart televisions?
column2: Apps.

column1: List two examples of app categories mentioned in the text.
column2: Games, shopping, navigation, office and work, email, and social media apps.

column1: Define Augmented Reality (AR).
column2: Augmented Reality (AR) makes use of real-world footage and superimposes digitally created graphics onto it.

column1: Which social media app is given as an example of AR for adding overlays onto a user's face?
column2: Snapchat.

column1: Which game is an example of AR that adds digital characters to places in the real world?
column2: Pokemon GO.

column1: What type of AR application is IKEA Place used for?
column2: Interior decoration, allowing furniture to be virtually added to a room.

column1: How does Virtual Reality (VR) differ from Augmented Reality (AR)?
column2: Virtual Reality (VR) creates an entirely computer-generated world, whereas AR overlays digital elements onto the real world.

column1: What is the primary design purpose of digital games?
column2: Digital games are designed to entertain.

column1: Name three types of devices on which digital games are played.
column2: Consoles, handheld computers, personal computers, smartphones, or tablet computers.

column1: What is the format of comics and graphic novels?
column2: They are paper-based print published products.

column1: Comics are described as being similar to what other print product?
column2: Magazines.

column1: Graphic novels are described as being similar to what other print product?
column2: Illustrated books.

column1: In which print product are comic strips often contained?
column2: Newspapers.

column1: What special display technology is characteristic of e-Books?
column2: A special display that uses e-ink.

column1: What is a key visual limitation of a typical e-ink screen?
column2: The screen is typically limited to black and white.

column1: What is the main advantage of an e-ink screen for reading outdoors?
column2: It reflects light like a real book, making it work very well in bright sunlight.

column1: For what type of written content are e-Books particularly well suited?
column2: Novels.

column1: Due to screen limitations, e-Books do not work well for what types of publications?
column2: Magazines or heavily illustrated books.

column1: What is a key role of websites in the media industry?
column2: To promote content and engage with users.

column1: What does the concept of multimedia products involve?
column2: The integration of various media types like text, images, video, and audio into a single product.

column1: What is a primary role of eBooks in the media industry?
column2: To facilitate the distribution and consumption of digital written content.

column1: How has the introduction of eBooks impacted the distribution of content?
column2: It has enabled instant, global distribution of books digitally, bypassing traditional physical printing and shipping.

column1: VR and AR contribute to media sectors by creating what kind of experiences?
column2: Immersive experiences.
